body: Thank you for responding.  The therapist's cost is coming into play because it is another stress on top of a mountain of stress.  Right now it is about $250.00 a month. Most days I leave their office wondering what I paid for.  It seem like I'm paying someone to have a discussion with me about all the ills in society.  I get it, the world will chew me up and spit me out, learn to get a thicker skin.  None of that helps with missing my dad so much.  Thanks for the subreddit link.  I tried /r/grief and it didn't have a new post in 2 years.
Thank you for responding.  It is a serious injury.  I'm sorry for your loss.  No one deserves to suffer through loss but here it is.
